node.title: Regular Expression to replace & in XML
node.author: denzil_cactus
node.doctext:
Hi Monks,

I have a XML file which has the content as below
BALANCE OF AMOUNT RECEIVED FROM H&# and I am trying to use a code to convert &# into blank
as per below however in this case character & should be untouched
BALANCE OF AMOUNT RECEIVED FROM H Below is the code.
sed -e 's/&//'
Please help here
